DISTRIBUTION. Tanzania (Map 1). The species is endemic to the Kilwa and Lindi Districts (Lindi Region) of southern Tanzania. It is possible that the species might yet be found in northern Mozambique but it was not recorded as wild there by Exell (1961).
Hibiscus hareyae mainly occurs (Kilwa, Lindi and Kiswa areas) on coral rag, a rubble-like limestone formed by uplift of former marine coral reefs.
